topicName: the role of the family in society

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Functionalist view: the family serves essential functions for society. Murdock (1949): the nuclear family is universal and performs four functions - sexual (regulates sexual behaviour), reproductive (produces next generation), economic (pools resources), educational (socialises children). Parsons: the family serves two 'irreducible' functions - primary socialisation of children and stabilisation of adult personalities (warm bath theory). | Key Fact: Marxist view: the family serves capitalism, not society as a whole. Zaretsky (1976): the family consumes capitalist products (TVs, cars, processed food) and provides unpaid domestic labour (women's housework reproduces the next generation of workers at no cost to the state).
